description: Closed vocabulary of dataset shapes carried in disease-insights manifests. Manifest entries' `type` field must be one of these ids.

items.label: Keyword clusters
items.description: Indication-scoped cluster set in the keyword-lexicon shape (id, label, description, indication, parent_theme, parent_subtheme, variants[]). Suggestion fuel for the autotag pipeline.

items.label: Search-volume topics
items.description: Topic-by-volume table (typically estimated monthly or aggregate query volume). Dimensions: topic. Measures: volume.

items.label: Patient community engagement
items.description: Engagement metrics for patient communities (e.g. Facebook groups), grouped by community type. Dimensions: group_type. Measures: avg_membership, avg_monthly_posts.

items.label: Digital ad spend time series
items.description: Monthly digital ad spend per branded domain. Dimensions: domain, month. Measures: estimated_spend.

items.label: ClinicalTrials.gov raw study records
items.description: Cached, unflattened CT.gov v2 study records for an indication. Envelope: { schema_version, queries[], fetched_at, raw_total_count_by_query, deduped_count, studies[] }. Each study carries its NCT id, matched_queries[] (which fetch queries returned it), and the full CT.gov protocolSection + derivedSection payload.

items.label: ClinicalTrials.gov normalized studies
items.description: Deterministic flatten of clinical_trials_raw. One row per NCT id with brief/official title, status + why_stopped, dates, phases, study_type, enrollment, lead_sponsor + collaborators[], conditions[], condition_keywords[], interventions[] (with name_key), locations[] (with geoPoint), eligibility (sex, age bounds in years, healthy_volunteers, criteria_text, etc.).

items.label: ClinicalTrials.gov sponsor occurrences
items.description: Per-name sponsor table derived from normalized studies: lead_count, collaborator_count, total_count, observed classes[], referenced NCT ids[]. Observation-only — does not merge against the live sponsors registry.

items.label: ClinicalTrials.gov intervention occurrences
items.description: Per-name_key intervention table derived from normalized studies: case-collapsed name_key, observed name_variants[], types[], count, referenced NCT ids[]. Observation-only — does not merge against the live drugs or mechanisms-of-action registries.
